meta.project_name: Say it, get paid (AI Builder's Day '26)
meta.summary: Money in: say an invoice, confirm it, share a public GST invoice with UPI, remind, record payment.

entities.name: Invoice
entities.user_value: A GST invoice I'd be proud to send, at its own link, that my client can pay from
entities.description: A tax invoice from the workspace to a customer. Saving it posts receivable, revenue and GST payable in the same transaction.

key_fields.name: number
key_fields.label: INV-<FY>-<0001>, sequential per workspace per financial year, unique per workspace, max 16 chars

key_fields.name: issue_date
key_fields.label: Issue date; also the ledger entry date

key_fields.name: due_date
key_fields.label: Due date; empty unless spoken or set (never guessed)

key_fields.name: place_of_supply
key_fields.label: Customer state; decides CGST+SGST vs IGST

key_fields.name: status
key_fields.label: Cached status; Who owes me reads the ledger, not this

key_fields.name: public_slug
key_fields.label: Unguessable link id, 6 random bytes base64url

key_fields.name: language
key_fields.label: Detected spoken language; the reminder uses it

key_fields.name: transcript
key_fields.label: What was said, kept for reference

transitions.guard: customer name, customer state, issue date, at least one line with description, positive quantity and rate, GST rate 0 to 28
transitions.ears: WHEN the owner confirms the invoice form THE SYSTEM SHALL find or create the customer, assign the next invoice number under a per-workspace lock, save the invoice and lines, AND post debit receivable / credit revenue / credit GST payable in one transaction.

transitions.guard: invoice belongs to the workspace and is open
transitions.ears: WHEN the owner marks an open invoice paid THE SYSTEM SHALL record a manual Payment for the full total, set status paid, AND post debit bank / credit receivable in one transaction.

transitions.guard: Pine Labs webhook verified (signature) and amount matches the invoice
transitions.ears: WHEN Pine Labs confirms a payment against the invoice THE SYSTEM SHALL record it and mark the invoice paid.

transitions.guard: invoice open and owned; no payment recorded
transitions.ears: WHEN the owner cancels an open invoice THE SYSTEM SHALL set it cancelled AND post a reversal entry mirroring its ledger entry, AND its public link SHALL show only 'This invoice was cancelled'.

state_machine.notes: draft is client-side only: the confirm form. Nothing is persisted before confirm (BR-SH-003). Cancel posts a reversal (OQ-INV-3); full editing stays cut.

mutations.user_value: Said once, saved right, books updated
mutations.ears: WHEN the owner taps Save on the invoice confirm form THE SYSTEM SHALL validate with InvoiceForm, compute totals and the GST split server-side, and save with its ledger entry.
mutations.optimistic_behavior: none; wait for the server, then go to the public invoice
mutations.rollback_behavior: transaction rolls back if the ledger entry doesn't balance; show the error on the form

mutations.user_value: Money arrived; it's off my list
mutations.ears: WHEN the owner taps Mark as paid THE SYSTEM SHALL post the payment and refresh Who owes me.
mutations.guard: idempotent: a paid invoice is left alone

entities.name: InvoiceLine
entities.user_value: Each thing I did, with its code and GST

entities.name: Payment
entities.user_value: I can see when I got paid
entities.description: Money received against an invoice. Today always the full total, method manual.

entities.name: Reminder
entities.user_value: A polite nudge in their language, ready to send, with a way to pay
entities.description: One drafted reminder for an open invoice: who drafted it, the message, any Pine Labs link, and the agent's run id and trace for the judges.

key_fields.name: message
key_fields.label: WhatsApp text, ends with the pay link

key_fields.name: payment_link
key_fields.label: Pine Labs link if the agent made one

key_fields.name: trace
key_fields.label: Agent output, tool calls, reasoning, error

entities.notes: Drafting is recorded; actually sending happens in WhatsApp and is not observed. '/stats reminders sent' therefore counts drafts.

journeys.name: say_an_invoice
journeys.trigger: Owner holds the mic button on Home

steps.action: Hold the mic and say it: 'Invoice Acme ₹40,000 for landing page design, 18% GST, due in 7 days.' In English, Hindi, Kannada or Malayalam.
Scribe returns the transcript and language; Claude returns invoice fields only (AGT-SCRIBE, AGT-EXTRACT).
Confirm form appears filled: customer, state (assumed same as yours, said so), lines with SAC codes, GST rate, due date. Amounts large. Empty fields ask.
Fix anything misheard; add the customer's WhatsApp number; Save.
Invoice saved with its number and ledger entry; land on the public invoice.

failure_paths: Mic denied or audio empty → type the invoice instead
Scribe fails → 'Couldn't hear that. Try again, a little closer to the mic.'
Extract misses a field → it stays empty and the form asks; GST rate is never guessed
Unbalanced ledger entry → save refused, nothing written
journeys.success_outcome: A numbered GST invoice exists at its own link and the receivable is in the books.
pain_points_surfaced: Amounts in Indian units ('1.5 lakh', 'saavira') are the most likely to be misheard

journeys.name: share_invoice
journeys.trigger: Invoice just saved, or opened from Home or Who owes me
preconditions: Viewer is the owning workspace (owner-only share bar)

steps.action: See the invoice as the customer will, with UPI QR and Pay button.
Tap Send on WhatsApp (wa.me with the customer's number and a prefilled message with the link) or Copy.

failure_paths: No customer phone → wa.me opens without a recipient; owner picks the chat
journeys.success_outcome: The customer has the link in WhatsApp.

journeys.name: customer_pays
journeys.trigger: Customer opens the invoice link from WhatsApp
preconditions: Invoice exists with a valid public slug

steps.action: Open the link: seller, GSTIN, customer, lines with SAC/HSN, CGST/SGST or IGST, total, due date.
Tap Pay (upi://pay to the owner's UPI ID with amount and invoice number) or scan the QR from another phone.

failure_paths: Desktop browser → upi:// does nothing; scan the QR
Payment made → nothing tells the system; the owner must mark it paid (see OQ-INV-1)
journeys.success_outcome: Money reaches the owner's UPI account. The books catch up only when the owner marks it paid.
pain_points_surfaced: Paid but still shows open, so a reminder could go to someone who already paid

journeys.name: send_reminder
journeys.trigger: Owner taps Send reminder on an open invoice in Who owes me

steps.action: AgenticOrg ar_collections picks a tone from days overdue (≤0 friendly heads-up, 1 to 14 polite, >14 firm but courteous), makes a Pine Labs link, drafts under 60 words in the invoice's language.
Preview the draft, the link and who drafted it (agent run, tone, tool calls).
Tap Send on WhatsApp or Copy. The owner sends it from WhatsApp.

failure_paths: AgenticOrg not configured or errors → Claude drafts against our invoice link
Agent message has no link → discarded in favour of the Claude draft
journeys.success_outcome: A reminder with a way to pay is in the customer's WhatsApp, sent by the owner.
pain_points_surfaced: Chasing feels awkward; a drafted, polite message in their language removes the awkwardness

journeys.name: mark_paid
journeys.trigger: Money arrived; owner taps Mark as paid

steps.action: Tap Mark as paid on the invoice row.
Payment posted; the customer's balance and the total drop.

journeys.success_outcome: Receivable down, bank up, invoice off the list.

journeys.name: find_an_old_invoice
journeys.trigger: A client asks for an invoice from months ago

steps.action: Open Invoices, search by customer, tap the invoice, reshare the link.

screens.name: Home
screens.notes: Mic and camera buttons, recent activity, the book totals. Without a workspace cookie / shows the landing page instead.

screens.name: InvoiceConfirm

business_rules.ears: WHEN the supplier state equals the place of supply THE SYSTEM SHALL split GST into CGST and SGST (CGST = floor(half), SGST = the rest); OTHERWISE it SHALL charge IGST.

business_rules.description: Unknown customer state means same state as the owner, shown on the form.
business_rules.ears: WHEN the customer state was not spoken THE SYSTEM SHALL default it to the owner's state AND SHALL say 'Assumed same state as you, so CGST and SGST. Change it if not.'

business_rules.description: Invoice numbers run in sequence per workspace per financial year.
business_rules.ears: WHEN an invoice is saved THE SYSTEM SHALL take a per-workspace advisory lock AND number it INV-<FY code>-<next 4-digit sequence> for that financial year.

business_rules.description: Totals are computed on the server, not trusted from the client.
business_rules.ears: WHEN an invoice is saved THE SYSTEM SHALL recompute line amounts, GST, split and total from quantity, rate, GST rate and the two states.

business_rules.description: Customers are matched by GSTIN, phone, or a confirmed name match.
business_rules.ears: WHEN an invoice names a customer THE SYSTEM SHALL treat a matching GSTIN or phone as the same customer, AND for a close name match SHALL ask 'Same as <name>?' on the confirm form before reusing or creating one.

business_rules.description: Reminder tone follows lateness; no reminder sends itself.
business_rules.ears: WHEN drafting a reminder THE SYSTEM SHALL choose a friendly heads-up at 0 or fewer days overdue, a polite reminder at 1 to 14, and firm but courteous over 14, AND SHALL NOT send it; the owner sends it from WhatsApp.

business_rules.description: Days overdue counts from the due date, or the issue date if there is none.
business_rules.ears: WHEN computing days overdue THE SYSTEM SHALL measure from the due date if set, ELSE from the issue date, to today in IST.
WHEN drafting a reminder THE SYSTEM SHALL write it in English regardless of the invoice's spoken language.

open_questions.plain: How does the app know a customer paid?
open_questions.question: The UPI deep link can't confirm payment, and a Pine Labs link from the agent isn't reconciled either: no webhook marks the invoice paid, and payment.method is only ever 'manual'. ROADMAP Month 1 promises 'the invoice marks itself paid'. For today, is manual Mark as paid enough, and should the public page tell the customer to send a screenshot?
open_questions.resolution: Onboard a payment gateway (Pine Labs). Its webhook confirms payment, and the system records a Payment (method pine_labs), marks the invoice paid and posts debit bank / credit receivable. Covers only payments that go through the gateway, so the gateway link/QR becomes the one way to pay on the invoice page and in reminders (see OQ-INV-8). Mark as paid stays for cash and direct transfers. Follow-ups: OQ-INV-10 (whose account receives the money), OQ-INV-11 (gateway fees and settlement in the books).

open_questions.plain: Do B2B invoices need the customer's GSTIN?
open_questions.question: customer.gstin exists and the public page reads it, but neither voice extract nor the confirm form captures it. A GST-registered customer needs it on the invoice to claim input credit. Add it to the confirm form (optional), and to the extract?
open_questions.resolution: Optional Customer GSTIN on the confirm form, checked like the owner's, remembered on the customer, printed on the invoice. The extractor picks it up if spoken.

open_questions.plain: What do you do about a wrong invoice after saving?
open_questions.question: Editing after save is cut (rank 5) and there is no cancel. GST practice is a credit note, not a delete. Today a misheard ₹4,00,000 saved instead of ₹40,000 sits in receivable and revenue forever. Minimum for today: a void that posts a reversing entry? Or accept it for the event?
evidence: Invoice state machine has no cancelled state
open_questions.resolution: Add 'Cancel invoice': marks it cancelled and posts a reversing ledger entry (credit-note style). The public link shows 'Cancelled'. The owner says it again to make a correct one. Full editing stays cut.

open_questions.plain: Can a customer pay part of an invoice?
open_questions.question: Mark as paid always records the full total. TDS makes this common: a client paying ₹40,000 of professional fees often sends ₹36,000 and deducts 10%. Do we support a partial or 'paid less TDS' amount today, or is TDS tracking strictly months 4 to 6?
open_questions.resolution: Mark as paid offers 'paid in full' or 'paid less 10% TDS'. The TDS part posts to a new tds_receivable account, so it is tracked for year end. Arbitrary part payments stay out. Note: a gateway link is for the full amount; a client paying less TDS through the gateway needs a link for 90%, or pays outside it and the owner marks it.

open_questions.plain: Mixed GST rates on one invoice?
open_questions.question: The extract returns one gst_rate for the whole invoice while each line stores its own. Is one spoken rate applied to every line the intended behaviour, with per-line edits on the form for the rare mixed case?
open_questions.resolution: One spoken rate applies to every line; the owner changes a line's rate on the form for the rare mixed case.

open_questions.question: Once paid an invoice drops off Who owes me, and Home shows only the last 8 items. 'Digging up an old invoice' is a weekly pain in README. Is an all-invoices list in today's scope or Month 1?
open_questions.resolution: Build a simple Invoices page today: every invoice newest first, paid or open, search by customer, tap to reshare.

open_questions.plain: Which language should the reminder be in?
open_questions.question: The reminder follows the language the owner spoke the invoice in. The customer may not read Kannada even if the owner speaks it. Should reminder language be a per-customer choice on the preview?
open_questions.resolution: Reminders are always in English, whatever language the invoice was spoken in.

open_questions.plain: Two ways to pay, two records?
open_questions.question: When the agent makes a Pine Labs link, the reminder carries it while the invoice page offers UPI. A customer could pay either; neither updates the books. Should the Pine Labs link also appear on the public invoice, so there is one place to pay?
open_questions.resolution: One way to pay: the gateway link/QR is on the public invoice and in every reminder. The raw upi:// QR to the owner's UPI ID is dropped once the gateway is live (kept only as a fallback if gateway keys are missing).

open_questions.question: Customers are matched by name only. 'Acme' and 'Acme Pvt Ltd' become two; two different 'Ravi's become one, merging what they owe. Acceptable for today?
open_questions.resolution: When the spoken name is close to an existing customer, the confirm form asks 'Same as <name>?' (yes or new). A matching GSTIN or phone counts as the same customer.

open_questions.plain: Whose bank account does the money go to?
open_questions.question: With hackathon test keys every gateway payment lands in one Pine Labs merchant account (ours). For real use each owner must receive their own money, which means signing up each owner as a sub-merchant under a platform account, with KYC, or each owner bringing their own Pine Labs account. Which model, and is the demo fine on our single test merchant?
open_questions.resolution: Demo on our single Pine Labs test merchant today. Pitch the platform model: each owner is onboarded as a sub-merchant with KYC and paid out to their own bank. Owner KYC and payouts are Month 1.

open_questions.plain: How do gateway fees show in the books?
open_questions.question: The gateway pays out the amount less its fee, usually a day later. Post the payment as debit 'gateway clearing' then move to bank on settlement, with the fee to expenses? Or debit bank the full amount and ignore fees for today?
open_questions.resolution: Full clearing account. A gateway payment posts debit pine_labs_clearing / credit receivable. On settlement, debit bank (payout) and debit expenses (gateway fee) / credit pine_labs_clearing. Needs the account added and a settlement event source (see intent-books.json).

exclusions.description: Editing an invoice after it is saved.
Reminders that send themselves when overdue.
Pine Labs live payments that mark the invoice paid.
